title: Breathing zone outdoor airflow.
officialText:
The outdoor airflow rate required in the breathing zone (V ) of the occupiable bz space or spaces in a zone shall be determined in accordance with Equation 4-1.

V = R P + R A (Equation 4-1) bz p z a z where:

A = Zone floor area: the net occupiable floor area of the space or spaces in the zone. z P = Zone population: the number of people in the space or spaces in the zone. z R = People outdoor air rate: the outdoor airflow rate required per person from Table 403.3. p R = Area outdoor air rate: the outdoor airflow rate required per unit area from Table 403.3. a
